baseline: BM25 on bangladesh_judgements_v3 at the 400-chunk cap, raw query, API tokenizer. It is the comparison point, not a production decision.
decision_rule: A variant counts as better than the baseline only if, on nDCG@10 for that language, the 95% paired bootstrap interval excludes zero, the Holm-adjusted p-value across the experiment's tests is below 0.05, and at least 90% of its top-10 results are graded. Keep a change only if it also doesn't lower known-item MRR by more than the interval's width and fits the latency budget.

experiments.name: Bangla-to-English query translation
experiments.hypothesis: Most relevant judgements are in English, so an English form of a Bangla query reaches them and raises Bangla nDCG@10.
experiments.evidence: With BM25, topic nDCG is 0.429 in Bangla and 0.883 in English on the same needs. A hand-written English form fused with the Bangla query reaches 0.694.
experiments.queries: Bangla and mixed queries in the benchmark and the lay set
experiments.cost: No new index. About 60 LLM calls, cached by prompt hash, about 5 minutes at 15 requests a minute. Cost per call unknown until llm/pricing.json is filled in.

experiments.name: Alternative embedding models
experiments.hypothesis: A stronger multilingual model separates Bangla text better and bridges Bangla queries to English judgements.
experiments.evidence: MiniLM scores 0.061 in Bangla, found 1 of 371 English judgements from Bangla queries, and reads only the first 128 tokens of each 600-word chunk.
experiments.cost: Needs a model download of several GB, and hours of CPU for 34,217 chunks. MiniLM indexed about 11 chunks a second; larger models will be much slower. Measure with --limit 200 before committing. Vectors go to evals/cache/embeddings, never into ChromaDB.
experiments.runner: index builder built; scoring not built yet

experiments.name: Chunks that fit the embedding model
experiments.hypothesis: Dense search is weak partly because MiniLM truncates at 128 tokens, so embedding several short windows per chunk raises recall.
experiments.evidence: max_seq_length is 128 and chunks are 600 words. In a sample of 1,500 chunks, 97.1% are cut off and the model reads a median of 80 words, or 57 in Bangla-script chunks (evals/reports/embedding_truncation.json).
experiments.cost: Several times the vectors of a normal build at about 11 windows a second, in evals/cache/embeddings. No ChromaDB change.
experiments.runner: not built; decide after E2's timing probe

experiments.name: Reranking BM25 results alone
experiments.hypothesis: Dense noise hurts hybrid, so reranking BM25's candidates keeps the reranker's gain on exact lookups without hybrid's losses.
experiments.evidence: Hybrid + rerank ties BM25, winning on known-item lookups and losing on topics and legal terms. It costs 36 seconds a query at 50 pairs.
experiments.cost: About 0.7 seconds a pair on CPU, so 7, 14 and 36 seconds a query when nothing is cached. For the 95 benchmark queries, depths 10 and 20 need 0 and 5 new pairs because the earlier run scored them, and depth 50 needs 2,257, about 26 minutes. Lay queries add new pairs. `--plan E3` shows the current figures.

experiments.name: Unicode, digit and light-stem normalization
experiments.hypothesis: Normalizing query and document tokens fixes cross-script case numbers and inflected Bangla words without hurting English.
experiments.evidence: All 6 cross-script case-number lookups failed. BM25's top 10 changed on 16 of 17 Bangla queries when typed with single-character letters. `দেনমোহর` doesn't match `দেনমোহরের`.
experiments.cost: An in-memory BM25 rebuild for each level, under a minute each. No ChromaDB change.

experiments.name: Large-document retrieval without changing the cap
experiments.hypothesis: Searching a case's full text once it's found recovers the passages the cap hides, and a per-case chunk limit stops one case filling the context.
experiments.evidence: BM25 finds Death Ref 58 first on all 8 content queries, but only 7% of a sample of rare words from it are in the index, and one case can fill all 10 chunk slots.
experiments.queries: Death Ref 58 queries for passage search; all non-known-item queries for the chunk limit
experiments.cost: Under a few minutes. Reads text_v3 only. The cap stays at 400.
